scores.notes: The Cheshire Cat floats top-centre with full furry body and clawed front paws rather than a bodiless head, and the King stands beside Alice facing the viewer instead of peering over her shoulder at the grin; Queen pointing at right, card courtiers and hoops otherwise fit.

Scribbled pseudo-writing on the Hatter's hat card and the flying slates (centre); the unselected Queen of Hearts sits prominently on the bench beside the King; Alice on the bench at left is no larger than the seated spectators, so her grown size does not read. Lizard upended in the tipping box is good.
Saul centred shielding his eyes under a column of cloud-like radiance, companions and donkeys recoiling, Damascus walls and domes at left; edges fully painted, no lettering or anatomy faults found.
Fire streaks fall from smoke-filled orange sky onto two burning mud-brick towns in the middle distance, fleeing figures in wraps in the foreground; no writing, edges painted to the corners.

A cursive-looking pseudo-letter squiggle sits on the floor at bottom left-centre (below the sandals, about x350 y690). Otherwise Samuel pours the horn on kneeling David among the brothers; paper edges are accepted.
Jesus stands at the stern with arm outstretched over the sea, eleven disciples huddled by the mast and rail, mist and rocky shores behind; hands and faces check out and no lettering.
Daniel small at lower left with lifted hands, two flaming wheels in fire and cloud above with no figure in the light, ziggurat city on the horizon; no lettering.
Jesus asleep on cushions in the stern while a disciple grips his shoulder and others cling to ropes and mast, swinging lamp, waves and rain; hands counted cleanly, edges painted.

The Caterpillar on the mushroom (right) has a human old-man face and wears a bowler hat and waistcoat, which the text does not give, so it is not drawn as an animal; Alice small at left with clasped hands, hookah smoke fine.
Ruth and Boaz seated centre with a small boy between them, women of Bethlehem around the courtyard, oven at right, closed scrolls on the left ledge carry no marks; edges painted.

Father embraces the ragged son at left by whitewashed houses while two servants approach from right with a blue robe and sandals; ring not visibly carried but scene reads, hands plausible, no lettering.
Father embraces the son, ring on his hand, two servants approach with robe and sandals by a whitewashed village and lake; pale sky corners are wash not blank paper, no lettering.
A cluster of plainly dressed villagers on the hillside gazing at the golden sky, one raising a hand, village lamps lit, small Roman soldier on the road at right; no lettering.
Golden light floods through the open city gate across the square with townsfolk, elders and merchants turning toward it; no human shape inside the light, no lettering.

Playing-card courtiers show corner indices (A on the left card, J and numerals on the cards along the back bench). The scene itself fits: Alice before the dais, King with note-book, Queen leaning in, animal jury with slates.
Ruth and Boaz seated with a boy standing between them, Naomi on the ledge, women seated around the courtyard, oven and scroll on ledge; no marks, edges painted.
Daniel calm at centre of the stone pit, radiant angel at his side, lions with closed mouths around him, Darius behind the barred gate above; no lettering or anatomy faults.
The titulus plaque on the cross (top right) carries scribbled pseudo-letter marks. Soldiers crouch casting lots over a stone with garments spread, and the crucifixion is shown without gore.
Saul centre with hands raised to his head under a burst of cloudy radiance, companions recoiling and one fallen, donkeys and dust, Damascus at left; no lettering.

The four creatures (lion, calf, man, eagle) wear draped stoles and the calf in particular looks tame and cute rather than strange and fearsome; eyes appear only on the wings. Empty throne, so no unseen figure drawn.

Pseudo-text columns and a masthead on the newspapers (lower left) and numerals on the mantel clock (top right); Holmes's gaunt face with swept-back hair closely resembles Peter Cushing's screen Holmes.
Samuel pours oil onto kneeling David with Jesse and brothers around them, fleece and staff set aside at lower left, Bethlehem hillside behind; no lettering or anatomy faults.
Jesus raises his arm before the open rock tomb as bandaged Lazarus steps out, Martha and the astonished crowd at right; rolled stone and lamp present, no lettering.
Hezekiah in royal robe with open hand in the temple court, gilded temple doors with cherub relief (no glyphs), priests and bronze vessels; edges are pale sky wash.
Darius crouches pressing his signet into wax on the stone over the den mouth, lords with rings and torches witness behind, night sky; no lettering or anatomy faults.
Jesus asleep on a cushion while a disciple shakes him, others clutch the mast and a lamp in a storm-tossed boat; hands on the mast count correctly, no lettering.
